Interaction network generated by the STRING database with identification of functional clusters from CIPC

Interaction network generated by the STRING database with identification of functional clusters from CIPC. Legend: Interaction generated by the STRING database from 169 genes correlated with CIPC. These interactions are derived from databases and experimental data, as well as predicted interactions. A network analysis was performed from this network to identify the main clusters involved in the CIPC pathways
